summary: Yunhong Green CTI filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting a September 29, 2026 Conversion Restriction and Waiver Agreement with holders of all 130,000 Series E and all 70,000 Series F convertible preferred shares plus related warrants. In connection with a proposed public offering, holders agreed not to convert or transfer preferred/warrants during a restricted period ending 61 days after termination notice, not before the later of offering close/abandonment or the second anniversary. Warrants extended from March 11, 2027 to March 11, 2029; piggyback rights waived. Routine capital-structure housekeeping, not a special situation. Watch offering terms and potential dilution.
